The root ग्रह 'to seize' takes the affix क्यप् when it means a 'word', a 'dependent', 'outside' or a 'partisan'.

Terms: क्यप्

The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. पद् 'to pace' 2. रुज् 'to pain 3. विश् 'to enter' 4. स्पृश् 'to touch'.

Terms: घञ्

The affix ङीप् is optionally used in the feminine after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending with the word पाद्।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'who takes' after a word having पद as its second member, the word being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction.

Terms: ठक्

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'in it is visible' after the word पद being in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: यत्

The affix वुन् comes after the words 1. पाद and 2. शत when preceded by a numeral, the sense being that of distributive relation, and the final of the stem is elided.

Terms: वुन्

The affix यत् (यं) comes after the words 1. पाद and 2. अर्घ being in the Dative -4th Case in construction when the meaning is 'for the purpose of that'.

Terms: यत् (यं)

The final अ of पाद is elided when it is at the end of a बहुव्रीहि समास preceded by a word denoting a thing with which it is compared but not so when such word is हस्ति etc.

Terms:

In the weak cases (beginning with the accusative plural) the following stems are substituted: पद for पाद , दत् for दन्त , नस् for नासिका , मास् for मास , हृद् for हृदय , निश for निशा , असन् for असृज् , यूषन् for यूष , दोषन् for दास् , यकन् for यकृत् , शकन् for शकृत् , उदन् for उदक and आसन् for आस्य।

Terms:

The augment त् is added optionally to a long vowel final in a full word (पद) when followed by छ।

Terms: संहितायाम्

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word पद denoting 'a pretext'.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

पद् is substituted for पाद before 1. आजि 2. आति 3. ग and 4. उपहत।

Terms: Some Substitution

पद् is substituted for पाद before the affix यत् used in any sense other than that of 'suited there to'.

Terms: Some Substitution

For पाद is substituted पद् when the former is भ।

Terms: भ substitution
The sūtra द्वारादीनां च

is optionally applied to श्वन् followed by पद।

Terms: वृद्धि
Up to इडाया वा

, inclusive, should be always supplied in every subsequent sūtra the phrase 'of a word' or 'to the whole of a word'.

Terms: Doubling of Words
Up to सगतिरपि तिङ्

, inclusive, should always be supplied the phrase 'after a पद'.

Terms: Doubling of Words

Of a न् final in a पद , ण् is not the substitute.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्

The न् is not changed to ण् when a पद intervenes between the cause of the change and the word containing the न्।

Terms: सन्धि-हल्
